ready_story_angle: A teacher and writer whose literary life extended across poems, plays and children’s stories in Odia and Sambalpuri; Bhukha reached cinema, and later English translation offers another way back to the play. Keep literary work central, without retelling entire existing film article.
ready_paraphrase: Manglu Charan Biswal wrote across forms and audiences: plays, poems and children’s stories, in both Odia and Sambalpuri. His work was larger than the film through which many readers may encounter his name. The Sambalpuri play Bhukha became the basis of Sabyasachi Mohapatra’s film; an English translation, The Starved, by Nirjharini Tripathy was published by Hachette India in2023. These are distinct routes through which a written play can meet new audiences, not evidence that all adaptations preserve every feature of the original.
